name: Bestow Curse

upcast.text: Level 4 slot: Concentration up to 10 minutes. Level 5-6 slot: no Concentration, 8 hours. Level 7-8 slot: no Concentration, 24 hours. Level 9 slot: until dispelled.

summary: Touched creature fails a Wisdom save and is cursed with one of four penalties you choose.
text: Touch a creature; it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is cursed until the spell ends, suffering one effect of your choice: (1) choose an ability: the target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use it; (2) the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you; (3) in combat, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns and, on a failure, must take the Dodge action that turn; (4) whenever you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell, it takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: with a level 4 slot you can keep Concentration for up to 10 minutes; with a level 5 or 6 slot the spell needs no Concentration and lasts 8 hours; with a level 7 or 8 slot it needs no Concentration and lasts 24 hours; with a level 9 slot it lasts until dispelled.
